nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that builds Wavee.UI.WinUI as signed MSIX packages for x64 and ARM64 on tag push, using Azure Artifact Signing, and attaches them as artifacts on a draft GitHub Release.
nodes.languageNotes: Matrix strategy runs build-sign job in parallel for x64 and arm64; release job depends on both matrix legs via needs: build-sign and only runs on tag pushes.

nodes.name: build-sign
nodes.summary: CI job that checks out the repo, restores NuGet packages, builds and packages MSIX via MSBuild, signs the package using Azure Trusted Signing, and uploads the signed MSIX as a workflow artifact.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: CI job that downloads the signed MSIX artifacts from both matrix legs and creates a draft GitHub Release with auto-generated release notes, triggered only on tag pushes.
